q1.question: Can I change plans at any time?
q1.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your subscription at any time. The change takes effect immediately and the difference is calculated pro rata.

q2.question: Is there a minimum commitment?
q2.answer: No, our subscriptions have no commitment. You can cancel at any time from your account settings.

q4.question: How does the free trial work?
q4.answer: The Starter plan is free forever. You can try all Pro features for 14 days without a credit card.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: VisioConnect was born from a simple observation: video communication has become essential, but existing tools were either too complex, unsecure, or too expensive.
story.p2: We gathered a team of passionate engineers and designers to build a platform that puts the user first. After months of intensive development, we launched a solution that combines the highest video quality with a dead-simple interface.
story.p3: Today, VisioConnect helps thousands of businesses, schools, and families stay close, no matter the distance.
